| `errorprone.CatchAndPrintStackTrace` | error | correctness |  | Never print stack traces in catch blocks; log them. |

| `errorprone.ShortCircuitBoolean` | error | correctness |  | Use && and \|\| instead of & and \| on booleans. |
| `errorprone.UnnecessaryParentheses` | error | correctness |  | Remove redundant parentheses. |
| `errorprone.UnnecessaryAnonymousClass` | error | correctness |  | Replace anonymous classes that can be lambdas. |
| `errorprone.UnusedLabel` | error | correctness |  | Remove unused labels. |
| `errorprone.UnusedNestedClass` | error | correctness |  | Remove unused nested classes. |
| `errorprone.MissingSummary` | error | correctness |  | Give every Javadoc comment a summary sentence. |
| `errorprone.MultipleTopLevelClasses` | error | correctness |  | Declare one top-level class per file. |
| `errorprone.ClassNewInstance` | error | correctness |  | Use getDeclaredConstructor().newInstance instead of Class.newInstance. |
| `errorprone.CatchFail` | error | correctness |  | Never catch an exception in a test only to call fail; declare throws. |
| `errorprone.DoubleBraceInitialization` | error | correctness |  | Never use double brace initialization. |
| `errorprone.FloatingPointLiteralPrecision` | error | correctness |  | Write floating-point literals that are exactly representable or explain the rounding. |
| `errorprone.EqualsUnsafeCast` | error | correctness |  | Check the type with instanceof before casting in equals. |

| Id | Default | Category | Sonar | Agent text |

| `spotbugs.CORRECTNESS` | error | correctness |  | Fix SpotBugs correctness bugs: they are almost always real defects. |
